# Ventari

> AI automation and compliance studio for SMEs and Mittelstand companies in Europe.

Ventari helps companies identify, build and govern practical AI systems. Core topics include AI opportunity assessment, workflow automation, system integration, EU AI Act compliance, GDPR-aware AI architecture, AI governance and AI project cost planning.
